The employment JPG is the blank form supplied by the repository owner for this
regression. All answer values are fictional and the SSN is deliberately invalid.

`employment-truth.json` is a manually labeled **test oracle**, inherited from the
earlier reviewed demonstration. It is read by Node assertions only. The application
does not import it, select this form by hash, or use these coordinates to place
answers. The browser detects the uploaded JPG using its own pixels, local OCR, and
structural analysis. The test compares the resulting reading order and locations
against the oracle, then fills the real UI with the ordered sample values.

The signature fixture is generated by the browser test. The employment form has no
signature line, so signature detection and placement are tested separately.
